brackets.source_title: Tax rates — income tax year 2026 (assessment year 2027)
brackets.notes: Official brackets: 25% up to EUR 16,720; 40% from EUR 16,720 to 29,510; 45% from EUR 29,510 to 51,070; 50% above EUR 51,070. Applied to taxable income, not directly to gross salary.

basic_personal_tax_allowance.source_title: Tax rates — personal tax allowance, income tax year 2026
basic_personal_tax_allowance.notes: Basic allowance only. It may increase depending on personal circumstances. Do not treat this amount alone as the final tax reduction; the legal calculation of the tax on the allowance and family increases must be modelled.

rate.notes: Official RSZ page states 13.07% for employees in the private sector. Low-wage employees do not pay the full amount where the work bonus applies. Confirm exact year-specific validity and covered remuneration before release. Do not generalise this rate to all public-sector categories or special regimes.

value.reference_wage: S = W (J = D); S = (W/J) x D (J < D); part-time: S = (W/H) x U

method.source_title: Administratieve instructies RSZ 2026/3 — Werkbonus, berekening in drie stappen
method.rounding: W/J and W/H: nearest eurocent (0,005 EUR wordt 0,01 EUR); J/D and H/U: two decimals (0,005 wordt 0,01), max 1; R: rekenkundig afgerond op de dichtstbijzijnde eurocent
method.notes: Verbatim rules: S is based on the gross wage at 100% for both arbeiders and bedienden; P = R (full prestaties), P = (J/D) x R or P = (H/U) x R; P may not exceed the personal social-security contributions due, and any shortfall is cut first from luik B and then from luik A. J and H count prestatiecodes 1, 3, 4, 5, 20 and, from version 2026/3, 38. Provisional because (1) rounding P to the eurocent is only shown in the official worked examples, not stated as a rule; (2) how the annual cap applies when it changes within the year is not stated; (3) the meaning and effective date of prestatiecode 38 are not given. Exclusions from W (looncodes 3, 6, 13, 14, 15, 16, 22, 23, end-of-year premiums up to S, departure holiday pay) and the flat 80,57 EUR reduction of S for a limited group of employers are not modelled.

professional_withholding.source_title: Calcul du précompte professionnel — règles et formule-clé 2026
professional_withholding.notes: The official FPS Finance page lists 2026 rules effective 1 January, a key formula and a 2026 simulator. The formula and underlying rules must be extracted and implemented before estimating monthly withholding.

professional_expenses.source_title: Tax rates — professional expenses are deducted from professional income
professional_expenses.notes: The official tax page confirms that flat-rate professional expenses are deducted from most professional income, including wages, but does not provide the 2026 calculation details in the page summary. Amounts, ceilings and conditions remain pending until an exact official source is documented.

special_social_security_contribution.notes: Applicable scale, household-income conditions, periodicity and annual reconciliation have not yet been transcribed from a specific official source. No estimate is permitted.
